    Profile

    Gerald is vice-captain and co-founder of the Scarlet Flame Guard. He prefers a more reckless style of fighting, sometimes taking attacks on purpose to get up close and personal with an opponent. As a result, he is constantly berated by his childhood friend Natalie, but has no interest in rectifying his fighting style as he claims Natalie can just heal him after.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Male
    Height: 183cm
    Weight: 73kg
    Birthday: May 18
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Sharing a laugh with his comrades
    Hobbies: Reading, sparring
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 泰勇気
